sampling.method: whole groups: a group is one agent on one of a user's tasks, its run with no attack and its runs under the important_instructions attack (one with no attack and at least 3 attacked, or the group is left out); each agent's groups ordered by sha256(seed + "agents" + group), the first 3 whose task is in the dev half and the first 3 whose task is in the test half taken with every run in them; every file checked against the git blob hash at the commit and kept byte for byte
sampling.split: each task (suite, user task) is in the dev or the test half by sha256(seed + "split" + task), the same halves as proof/outside/agentdojo/manifest.json
